note: Small, remote Gunnison NF campground at ~10,000 ft beside the Fossil Ridge Wilderness, 7 mi north of Ohio City on FR 771 (from US 50 at Parlin via CR 76). The dirt road is maintained but narrows to 1-1.5 lanes past the old gold mines; no winter maintenance. Spruce-fir and aspen; alpine lakes and trailheads nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed free, first-come only, vault toilet, no potable water. Site count 6 cleared (aggregators only; the FS gives no count or length). No agency length figure, so the note's '25 ft max (small rigs only)' was aggregator text and is dropped. Season left as stored. Pin 75 m from the FS point. Note trimmed.
flags: RIG-LENGTH: no agency wording or figure - the FS page states neither a length nor 'small rigs'. The note's '25 ft max length (small rigs only)' came from aggregators (AllStays/Roadtrippers 25 ft; one lists 10 ft); no dated own-rig review of a 23-ft+ rig found (Campendium 'longest vehicle reported 25 ft', undated). Kept; max_rig_ft stays absent.

Closure (past): Gold Creek Bridge Closure Order closed the NFSR 771 bridge 0.1 mi northeast of the campground entrance (and the last 1.6 mi of FR 771 beyond it) March 17 - July 3, 2026; the campground itself sits before the bridge. Order end date has passed; still listed on the GMUG alerts page.

Season: FS 'Seasons of Use | Late May' plus 'Winter Access depends on visitors' ability to traverse any conditions - if road is accessible. Be prepared for winter camping. No winter maintenance on road' - reads as no closing date (camping in winter if you can get there). Stored year_round false left alone; no open/close dates stated.
Waterfront (stored not waterfront): imagery is snow-covered and under canopy; Gold Creek/Lamphier Creek runs past the campground - not assessable from this frame, left alone.
